up: Retrieve a list of approved drugs and their associated indications. Join molecule_dictionary and drug_indication on molregno. Filter for approved drugs where max_phase = 4. Return the drug name (pref_name), ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), MeSH heading (mesh_heading), and EFO term (efo_term). Apply DISTINCT to ensure unique rows. Do not apply any row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4
